description: Two same-named columns from different joined tables are auto-disambiguated instead of rejected

columns.name: id_1
columns.note: users.id -- suffixed by the same rule the parameter path applies to duplicate parameter names

name: join_duplicate_column_names_disambiguated
query_sql:
-- @name ListUserPostIds
-- @returns :many
SELECT u.id, p.id FROM users u JOIN posts p ON p.user_id = u.id
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE posts (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL)
